DecorCurves Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Effective Date: January 1, 2025

Welcome to the DecorCurves Affiliate Program! By joining our program, you agree to abide by the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.

1. Eligibility

1.1. You must be at least 18 years old to participate in the DecorCurves Affiliate Program.
1.2. Acceptance into the program is subject to our review and approval. We reserve the right to decline any application at our discretion.

2. Enrollment

2.1. To join, complete the affiliate application form on the DecorCurves website.
2.2. Approval will be communicated via email upon successful review of your application.

3. Affiliate Responsibilities

3.1. Promote DecorCurves products (home and decor items) in a legal, ethical, and brand-aligned manner.
3.2. Comply with the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) guidelines, including proper disclosure of affiliate links.
3.3. Avoid making false, misleading, or exaggerated claims about our products.

4. Affiliate Links and Tracking

4.1. Upon acceptance, you will receive a unique affiliate tracking link.
4.2. Affiliate sales will be tracked using cookies valid for 30 days.
4.3. DecorCurves is not responsible for untracked sales due to technical issues such as cookie deletion or browser settings.

5. Commission Structure

5.1. Affiliates earn a 10% commission on the net sale amount (excluding taxes, shipping, and discounts).
5.2. Commission payouts will occur monthly, provided you meet the minimum payout threshold of $50.
5.3. Commissions on returned, canceled, or fraudulent transactions will be voided.

6. Payment

6.1. Payments will be made via [e.g., PayPal or direct deposit].
6.2. Affiliates must provide accurate payment details and update them as necessary. DecorCurves is not responsible for delayed or failed payments due to incorrect information.

7. Prohibited Activities

7.1. Affiliates may not:

  • Bid on “DecorCurves” or related keywords in paid advertising campaigns.
  • Use spam, unsolicited emails, or misleading methods for promotion.
  • Misrepresent DecorCurves or its products.
    7.2. Violations of these rules may result in the immediate termination of your account and forfeiture of commissions.

8. Termination

8.1. Either party may terminate this agreement at any time with written notice.
8.2. Upon termination, affiliate accounts will be deactivated, and commissions on sales after termination will not be paid.

9. Intellectual Property

9.1. Affiliates may use only approved marketing materials provided by DecorCurves.
9.2. Unauthorized use of our logo, trademarks, or proprietary content is prohibited.

10. Limitation of Liability

10.1. DecorCurves will not be held liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your participation in the affiliate program.

11. Governing Law

11.1. This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the United States and the state of [Your State].

12. Amendments

12.1. DecorCurves reserves the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time. Affiliates will be notified of significant changes.

By joining the DecorCurves Affiliate Program, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these terms and conditions.
